award_recognitions_values_check.name: award_recognitions_values_check
award_recognitions_values_check.value: btrim("award_recognitions"."organization_slug") <> '' and btrim("award_recognitions"."organization_name") <> '' and btrim("award_recognitions"."category") <> '' and ("award_recognitions"."year" is null or "award_recognitions"."year" between 1900 and 2100) and "award_recognitions"."position" >= 0

award_recognitions_owner_check.name: award_recognitions_owner_check
award_recognitions_owner_check.value: ("award_recognitions"."category_id" is null and "award_recognitions"."ceremony_id" is null) or "award_recognitions"."organization_id" is not null

installment_scores_range_check.name: installment_scores_range_check
installment_scores_range_check.value: ("installment_scores"."story" is null or "installment_scores"."story" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."characters" is null or "installment_scores"."characters" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."depth" is null or "installment_scores"."depth" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."world_building" is null or "installment_scores"."world_building" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."originality" is null or "installment_scores"."originality" between 0 and 10) and ("installment_scores"."craft" is null or "installment_scores"."craft" between 0 and 10)

media_assets_values_check.name: media_assets_values_check
media_assets_values_check.value: "media_assets"."byte_size" > 0 and "media_assets"."width" > 0 and "media_assets"."height" > 0 and "media_assets"."focal_x" between 0 and 100 and "media_assets"."focal_y" between 0 and 100

media_files_location_check.name: media_files_location_check
media_files_location_check.value: ("media_files"."library_root_id" is null and "media_files"."relative_path" is null) or ("media_files"."library_root_id" is not null and "media_files"."relative_path" is not null and "media_files"."relative_path" <> '' and "media_files"."relative_path" not like '/%' and "media_files"."relative_path" !~ '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)')

media_files_values_check.name: media_files_values_check
media_files_values_check.value: ("media_files"."byte_size" is null or "media_files"."byte_size" >= 0) and ("media_files"."sha256" is null or "media_files"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and "media_files"."availability" in ('unknown','present','missing','unreadable') and jsonb_typeof("media_files"."probe_metadata")='object'

media_tracks_source_check.name: media_tracks_source_check
media_tracks_source_check.value: ("media_tracks"."source"='embedded' and "media_tracks"."stream_index" is not null and "media_tracks"."relative_path" is null) or ("media_tracks"."source"='external' and "media_tracks"."kind"='subtitle' and "media_tracks"."stream_index" is null and "media_tracks"."relative_path" is not null and "media_tracks"."relative_path" <> '' and "media_tracks"."relative_path" not like '/%' and "media_tracks"."relative_path" !~ '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)')
